table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	invcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode, 
	customer = Max(dbo.accounts.name),
	date = CASE lower(:as_datetype) 
					When 'originaldate' Then Max(dbo.saleledger.originaldate) 
					When 'lastsavingdate' Then Max(dbo.saleledger.date)
					When 'billingdate' Then Max(dbo.saleledger.billingdate)
		  End , 
	refno = max(dbo.saleledger.custrefno),
	regno = Max(dbo.patient.regno),
	patient = Max(dbo.patient.name),
	fname = MAX(dbo.patient.fname),
	rank = Max(dbo.rank.name),
	unit = Max(dbo.unit.name),
	relation = Max(dbo.relation.name) ,
	disease = Max(dbo.disease.name) ,
	doctor = Max(dbo.doctors.name),
	itemname = Max(item.name),
	packing  = Max(item.packingdesc),
	manufacturer = Max(dbo.manufacturer.Name),
	price    = Max(dbo.saledetail.saleprice),
	looseqty = Sum(dbo.saledetail.looseqty)
	
FROM 
	dbo.saleledger
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.Relation ON (dbo.saleledger.relationcode = dbo.relation.relationcode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.disease ON (dbo.saleledger.diseasecode = dbo.disease.diseasecode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.doctors ON (dbo.saleledger.doctcode = dbo.doctors.doctcode),
	dbo.saledetail,    
	dbo.item, 
	dbo.manufacturer,
	dbo.Customer,
	dbo.Patient,
	dbo.Rank,
	dbo.Unit,
	dbo.Accounts
WHERE  
	CASE lower(:as_datetype) 
		When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate 
		When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.date
		When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.billingdate
	End Between :ad_startdate And :ad_enddate    AND
	dbo.saleledger.custcode  IN ( :al_custcode ) AND
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) AND
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode AND
	dbo.saledetail.icode = item.icode AND
	item.manfcode = dbo.manufacturer.manfcode AND
	dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode AND
	dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode AND
	dbo.patient.rankcode = dbo.rank.rankcode AND
	dbo.patient.unitcode = dbo.unit.unitcode AND
	dbo.saleledger.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode
Group By 
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,
	dbo.saledetail.icode,
	dbo.saledetail.rowgroup
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	invcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode, 
	customer = Max(dbo.accounts.name),
	date = CASE lower(:as_datetype) 
					When 'originaldate' Then Max(dbo.saleledger.originaldate) 
					When 'lastsavingdate' Then Max(dbo.saleledger.date)
					When 'billingdate' Then Max(dbo.saleledger.billingdate)
		  End , 
	refno = max(dbo.saleledger.custrefno),
	regno = Max(dbo.patient.regno),
	patient = Max(dbo.patient.name),
	fname = MAX(dbo.patient.fname),
	rank = Max(dbo.rank.name),
	unit = Max(dbo.unit.name),
	relation = Max(dbo.relation.name) ,
	disease = Max(dbo.disease.name) ,
	doctor = Max(dbo.doctors.name),
	itemname = Max(item.name),
	packing  = Max(item.packingdesc),
	manufacturer = Max(dbo.manufacturer.Name),
	price    = Max(sd.saleprice),
	looseqty = Sum(sd.looseqty)
FROM 	 
	dbo.saleledger
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.Relation ON (dbo.saleledger.relationcode = dbo.relation.relationcode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.disease ON (dbo.saleledger.diseasecode = dbo.disease.diseasecode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.doctors ON (dbo.saleledger.doctcode = dbo.doctors.doctcode),
	dbo.saleinvdetail sd, 
	dbo.item, 
	dbo.manufacturer,
	dbo.Customer,
	dbo.Patient,
	dbo.Rank,
	dbo.Unit,
	dbo.Accounts
WHERE  
	DBO.SaleLedger.impactinventory = 'N' AND 
	CASE lower(:as_datetype) 
		When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate 
		When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.date
		When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.billingdate
	End Between :ad_startdate And :ad_enddate    AND
	dbo.saleledger.custcode  IN ( :al_custcode ) AND
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) AND
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND
	sd.icode = item.icode AND
	item.manfcode = dbo.manufacturer.manfcode AND
	dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode AND
	dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode AND
	dbo.patient.rankcode = dbo.rank.rankcode AND
	dbo.patient.unitcode = dbo.unit.unitcode AND
	dbo.saleledger.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode
Group By 
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,
	sd.icode,
	sd.rowgroup
